{'text': 'Apple Invites 應用程式今日再次更新，新增 RSVP 回覆功能改進以及更大的主畫面小工具。詳情如下。', 'paragraph_context': 'The Apple Invites app got updated yet again today, with new features including RSVP improvements and a larger Home Screen widget. Here are the details.'}

{'text': 'Apple Invites 推出新更新', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple Invites gets new update'}

{'text': 'Apple Invites 應用程式在兩星期前才新增全解像度相片分享及全新 Image Playground 功能後，今日再次更新，帶來賓客管理及主畫面小工具方面的改進。', 'paragraph_context': 'Just two weeks after gaining full-resolution photo sharing and new Image Playground capabilities, the Apple Invites app got updated yet again today, with improvements to guest management and Home Screen widgets.'}

{'text': '隨著今次更新，該應用程式現可支援 iOS 27 引入的全新特大尺寸小工具，並讓 RSVP 回覆追蹤變得更容易。', 'paragraph_context': "With today's update, the app can now leverage the new extra-large widget introduced with iOS 27, and makes it easier to track RSVPs."}

{'text': '以下是 Apple Invites 1.12.1 版的完整更新日誌：', 'paragraph_context': "Here's Apple's the full release notes for Apple Invites v 1.12.1:"}

  • {'text': '主辦方現可更輕鬆地手動新增賓客到活動並標記其 RSVP 回覆狀態，即使有人在應用程式以外確認出席，賓客名單仍能保持準確。', 'paragraph_context': 'Hosts can now more easily manually add guests to the event and mark their RSVP status, so your guest list stays accurate even when someone confirms outside the app.'}
  • {'text': 'Invites 小工具現支援特大尺寸，讓你在主畫面上有更多倒數選項。', 'paragraph_context': 'Invites widget now supports the extra large size to give you more options to countdown on your Home Screen.'}
  • {'text': '此更新包含錯誤修復及性能改進。', 'paragraph_context': 'This update contains bug fixes and performance improvements.'}

    • {'text': '想了解更多關於 Apple Invites 的資訊，請到 App Store 查閱。', 'paragraph_context': 'To learn more about Apple Invites, check it out on the App Store.'}
